items.title: Zcash developers want 20-second blocks just days after major speed upgrade
items.summary: Early data shows Zcash's orphan-block rate holding close to pre-upgrade levels despite blocks arriving three times faster, encouraging developers to push for another reduction.

items.title: Bitcoin faces U.S. CPI test as analysts warn inflation relief may not be enough
items.summary: Bitcoin trades below $75,000 ahead of the October inflation data. Analysts warning that sustainable recovery depends on improving liquidity and spot ETF demand rather than temporary macro relief.

items.title: Will stablecoins survive once the banks catch up?
items.summary: As crypto firms and banks converge, it is fair to ask what lasting advantage stablecoins have, argues Alessandro Hatami, founder of Pacemakers and former COO of Digital Banking at Lloyds Banking Group.

items.title: U.S. CPI rose stronger than expected 0.4% in October; core rate rose 0.3%

items.summary: Bitcoin slipped despite a Monday rebound in U.S. stocks, with spot ETFs losing $201 million as traders await October inflation data later today.

items.summary: The Capital Markets Alliance argues that the products fall under the Securities and Exchange Commission’s jurisdiction.

items.title: An 11-year-old Ethereum wallet moved $4.6 million and dodged a scam set up in minutes
items.summary: Bots spotted a wallet from Ethereum’s 2015 launch the moment it stirred and planted lookalike addresses in its history, but the owner sent the money to the right place anyway.

items.title: Bitcoin miner MARA sold 13,597 BTC for $1.1 billion in six weeks, plans to sell more
items.summary: MARA paid off every loan backed by its bitcoin and says the rest of its coins can fund AI datacenters.

items.title: XRP Ledger maps out quantum-proof accounts, with no extra fees for users
items.summary: The XRP Ledger Foundation’s design lets owners add a quantum-resistant key and switch off the old one, part of a roadmap that puts the network on track for a full transition by 2028.

items.title: Poland’s lower house backs sanctions bill covering crypto freezes
items.summary: The bill is now before the Senate and would broaden the grounds for adding people and companies to Poland’s national sanctions list.
